name: Source provenance patterns
description: Four provenance models with the same deduplicated native query graph.

name: 1 - Source array
description: A single native TREATS relationship contains an array of supporting chunk IDs.

name: Step 1 - Reset and constrain
description: Delete the demo graph and create stable entity identifiers.

name: Step 2 - Add DOC-1
description: Idempotently create entity mentions and one canonical relationship with its first source.
query:
MERGE (d:Document {documentId: 'DOC-1'})
SET d.title = 'Aspirin for migraine', d.version = 1
MERGE (c:Chunk {chunkId: 'DOC-1-C1'})
SET c.text = 'Aspirin treats migraine.'
MERGE (c)-[:PART_OF]->(d)
MERGE (drug:Entity:Drug {entityId: 'DRUG-ASPIRIN'})
  ON CREATE SET drug.name = 'Aspirin'
MERGE (indication:Entity:Indication {entityId: 'IND-MIGRAINE'})
  ON CREATE SET indication.name = 'Migraine'
MERGE (c)-[:MENTIONS {mentionId: 'DOC-1-C1|RUN-1|MENTION-1', start: 0, end: 7}]->(drug)
MERGE (c)-[:MENTIONS {mentionId: 'DOC-1-C1|RUN-1|MENTION-2', start: 15, end: 23}]->(indication)
MERGE (drug)-[r:TREATS]->(indication)
SET r.sourceChunkIds = CASE
  WHEN c.chunkId IN coalesce(r.sourceChunkIds, []) THEN r.sourceChunkIds
  ELSE coalesce(r.sourceChunkIds, []) + [c.chunkId]
END;

name: Step 3 - Add DOC-2
description: Idempotently reuse the entities and relationship and append the second source ID.
query:
MERGE (d:Document {documentId: 'DOC-2'})
SET d.title = 'Migraine therapies', d.version = 1
MERGE (c:Chunk {chunkId: 'DOC-2-C1'})
SET c.text = 'Migraine may be treated with aspirin.'
MERGE (c)-[:PART_OF]->(d)
MERGE (drug:Entity:Drug {entityId: 'DRUG-ASPIRIN'})
  ON CREATE SET drug.name = 'Aspirin'
MERGE (indication:Entity:Indication {entityId: 'IND-MIGRAINE'})
  ON CREATE SET indication.name = 'Migraine'
MERGE (c)-[:MENTIONS {mentionId: 'DOC-2-C1|RUN-1|MENTION-1', start: 29, end: 36}]->(drug)
MERGE (c)-[:MENTIONS {mentionId: 'DOC-2-C1|RUN-1|MENTION-2', start: 0, end: 8}]->(indication)
MERGE (drug)-[r:TREATS]->(indication)
SET r.sourceChunkIds = CASE
  WHEN c.chunkId IN coalesce(r.sourceChunkIds, []) THEN r.sourceChunkIds
  ELSE coalesce(r.sourceChunkIds, []) + [c.chunkId]
END;

name: Step 4 - Display the complete graph
description: Visualize the documents chunks mentions and canonical domain relationship.
query:
MATCH p=()-[]->()
RETURN p;

name: Step 5 - Query the domain graph
description: The application query uses one native relationship and no provenance nodes.
query:
MATCH p=(drug:Drug)-[r:TREATS]->(indication:Indication)
RETURN p;

name: Step 6 - Delete DOC-1
description: Remove DOC-1 and its values from shared relationship arrays.
query:
// Array provenance requires editing every affected shared relationship.
MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document {documentId: 'DOC-1'})
WITH d, collect(c) AS chunks, collect(c.chunkId) AS removedChunkIds
FOREACH (c IN chunks | DETACH DELETE c)
DETACH DELETE d
WITH removedChunkIds
MATCH ()-[r:TREATS]->()
WHERE any(chunkId IN coalesce(r.sourceChunkIds, []) WHERE chunkId IN removedChunkIds)
SET r.sourceChunkIds = [chunkId IN r.sourceChunkIds WHERE NOT chunkId IN removedChunkIds]
WITH r
WHERE size(r.sourceChunkIds) = 0
DELETE r;

name: Step 7 - Verify the result
description: DOC-2 and the canonical TREATS relationship remain.
query:
MATCH p=(drug:Drug)-[r:TREATS]->(indication:Indication)
RETURN p, r.sourceChunkIds AS remainingSources;

name: 2 - Source relationships
description: Source-specific native relationships coexist with one canonical native relationship.

name: Step 1 - Reset and constrain
description: Delete the demo graph and constrain stable IDs including relationship IDs.

name: Step 2 - Add DOC-1
description: Idempotently create one source relationship and its canonical query relationship.
query:
MERGE (d:Document {documentId: 'DOC-1'})
SET d.title = 'Aspirin for migraine', d.version = 1
MERGE (c:Chunk {chunkId: 'DOC-1-C1'})
SET c.text = 'Aspirin treats migraine.'
MERGE (c)-[:PART_OF]->(d)
MERGE (drug:Entity:Drug {entityId: 'DRUG-ASPIRIN'})
  ON CREATE SET drug.name = 'Aspirin'
MERGE (indication:Entity:Indication {entityId: 'IND-MIGRAINE'})
  ON CREATE SET indication.name = 'Migraine'
MERGE (c)-[:MENTIONS {mentionId: 'DOC-1-C1|RUN-1|MENTION-1', start: 0, end: 7}]->(drug)
MERGE (c)-[:MENTIONS {mentionId: 'DOC-1-C1|RUN-1|MENTION-2', start: 15, end: 23}]->(indication)
MERGE (drug)-[source:TREATS_SOURCE {sourceId: 'DOC-1-C1|TREATS'}]->(indication)
SET source.factId = 'DRUG-ASPIRIN|TREATS|IND-MIGRAINE',
    source.chunkId = 'DOC-1-C1', source.confidence = 0.91,
    source.extractorVersion = 'demo-v1'
MERGE (drug)-[r:TREATS {factId: 'DRUG-ASPIRIN|TREATS|IND-MIGRAINE'}]->(indication)
WITH drug, indication, r
MATCH (drug)-[currentSource:TREATS_SOURCE]->(indication)
WHERE currentSource.factId = r.factId
WITH r, count(currentSource) AS supportCount
SET r.supportCount = supportCount;

MERGE (indication:Entity:Indication {entityId: 'IND-MIGRAINE'})
  ON CREATE SET indication.name = 'Migraine'
MERGE (c)-[:MENTIONS {mentionId: 'DOC-2-C1|RUN-1|MENTION-1', start: 29, end: 36}]->(drug)
MERGE (c)-[:MENTIONS {mentionId: 'DOC-2-C1|RUN-1|MENTION-2', start: 0, end: 8}]->(indication)
MERGE (drug)-[source:TREATS_SOURCE {sourceId: 'DOC-2-C1|TREATS'}]->(indication)

name: Step 4 - Display the complete graph
description: Visualize source-specific and canonical relationships together.
query:
MATCH p=()-[]->()
RETURN p;

name: Step 5 - Query the domain graph
description: The application ignores TREATS_SOURCE and uses only TREATS.
query:
MATCH p=(drug:Drug)-[r:TREATS]->(indication:Indication)
RETURN p;

name: Step 6 - Delete DOC-1
description: Delete its source relationships then update only the touched canonical relationship.
query:
// Relationship properties are the only link back to source chunks in this model.
MATCH (c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document {documentId: 'DOC-1'})
WITH d, collect(c) AS chunks, collect(c.chunkId) AS chunkIds
MATCH ()-[source:TREATS_SOURCE]->()
WHERE source.chunkId IN chunkIds
WITH d, chunks, collect(DISTINCT source.factId) AS factIds, collect(source) AS sources
FOREACH (source IN sources | DELETE source)
FOREACH (c IN chunks | DETACH DELETE c)
DETACH DELETE d
UNWIND factIds AS factId
MATCH ()-[r:TREATS {factId: factId}]->()
OPTIONAL MATCH ()-[remaining:TREATS_SOURCE {factId: factId}]->()
WITH r, count(remaining) AS supportCount
SET r.supportCount = supportCount
WITH r, supportCount
WHERE supportCount = 0
DELETE r;

name: Step 7 - Verify the result
description: DOC-2 support and one canonical TREATS relationship remain.
query:
MATCH p=(drug:Drug)-[r:TREATS]->(indication:Indication)
MATCH (drug)-[source:TREATS_SOURCE]->(indication)
WHERE source.factId = r.factId
RETURN p, r.supportCount AS supportCount, collect(source.chunkId) AS remainingSources;

name: 3 - Fact plus query graph
description: Canonical Fact nodes manage provenance and materialize native domain relationships.

name: Step 1 - Reset and constrain
description: Delete the demo graph and constrain all stable identifiers.

name: Step 2 - Add DOC-1
description: Idempotently create entity provenance one Fact one support and one native projection.
query:
// One occurrence supports one canonical Fact; TREATS is derived query data.
MERGE (d:Document {documentId: 'DOC-1'})
SET d.title = 'Aspirin for migraine', d.version = 1
MERGE (c:Chunk {chunkId: 'DOC-1-C1'})
SET c.text = 'Aspirin treats migraine.'
MERGE (c)-[:PART_OF]->(d)
MERGE (drug:Entity:Drug {entityId: 'DRUG-ASPIRIN'})
  ON CREATE SET drug.name = 'Aspirin'
MERGE (indication:Entity:Indication {entityId: 'IND-MIGRAINE'})
  ON CREATE SET indication.name = 'Migraine'
MERGE (c)-[:MENTIONS {mentionId: 'DOC-1-C1|RUN-1|MENTION-1', start: 0, end: 7}]->(drug)
MERGE (c)-[:MENTIONS {mentionId: 'DOC-1-C1|RUN-1|MENTION-2', start: 15, end: 23}]->(indication)
MERGE (f:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ASPIRIN|TREATS|IND-MIGRAINE'})
  ON CREATE SET f.predicate = 'TREATS'
MERGE (f)-[:SUBJECT]->(drug)
MERGE (f)-[:OBJECT]->(indication)
MERGE (c)-[support:SUPPORTS {
  supportId: 'DOC-1-C1|RUN-1|OCC-1'
}]->(f)
SET support.subjectMentionId = 'DOC-1-C1|RUN-1|MENTION-1',
    support.objectMentionId = 'DOC-1-C1|RUN-1|MENTION-2',
    support.confidence = 0.91, support.extractorVersion = 'demo-v1',
    support.extractionRunId = 'RUN-1'
MERGE (drug)-[r:TREATS {factId: f.factId}]->(indication)
WITH f, r
MATCH (:Chunk)-[currentSupport:SUPPORTS]->(f)
WITH r, count(currentSupport) AS supportCount
SET r.supportCount = supportCount;

name: Step 5 - Inspect provenance
description: Show that two chunks support one canonical Fact.
query:
MATCH (d:Document)<-[:PART_OF]-(c:Chunk)-[s:SUPPORTS]->(f:Fact)
MATCH (f)-[:SUBJECT]->(subject:Entity)
MATCH (f)-[:OBJECT]->(object:Entity)
RETURN subject.name AS subject, f.predicate AS predicate, object.name AS object,
       count(DISTINCT d) AS documentCount,
       collect({document: d.documentId, chunk: c.chunkId,
                subjectMentionId: s.subjectMentionId,
                objectMentionId: s.objectMentionId, confidence: s.confidence,
                extractorVersion: s.extractorVersion,
                extractionRunId: s.extractionRunId}) AS sources;

name: Step 6 - Query the domain graph
description: The application-facing query does not traverse Fact nodes.
query:
MATCH p=(drug:Drug)-[r:TREATS]->(indication:Indication)
RETURN p;

name: Step 6b - Cite the domain relationship
description: Traverse from the native query graph to the chunks and documents that support it.
query:
MATCH (drug:Drug)-[r:TREATS]->(indication:Indication)
MATCH (f:Fact {factId: r.factId})<-[s:SUPPORTS]-(c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document)
RETURN drug.name AS subject, type(r) AS predicate, indication.name AS object,
       d.documentId AS documentId, d.title AS source, c.chunkId AS chunkId,
       c.text AS excerpt, s.confidence AS confidence,
       s.extractorVersion AS extractorVersion,
       s.subjectMentionId AS subjectMentionId,
       s.objectMentionId AS objectMentionId;

name: Step 7 - Update DOC-1 part 1
description: Remove DOC-1 then clean up only the Facts and entities touched by its chunks.
query:
// Capture touched IDs before deleting document-owned chunks and supports.
MATCH (d:Document {documentId: 'DOC-1'})<-[:PART_OF]-(c:Chunk)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:MENTIONS]->(entity:Entity)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:SUPPORTS]->(f:Fact)
WITH d, collect(DISTINCT c) AS chunks,
     [id IN collect(DISTINCT f.factId) WHERE id IS NOT NULL] AS factIds,
     [id IN collect(DISTINCT entity.entityId) WHERE id IS NOT NULL] AS entityIds
FOREACH (c IN chunks | DETACH DELETE c)
DETACH DELETE d
CALL (factIds) {
  // Reconcile only touched Facts and their native projections.
  UNWIND factIds AS factId
  MATCH (f:Fact {factId: factId})
  MATCH (f)-[:SUBJECT]->(subject:Entity)
  MATCH (f)-[:OBJECT]->(object:Entity)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (:Chunk)-[support:SUPPORTS]->(f)
  WITH f, subject, object, factId, count(support) AS supportCount
  OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[r:TREATS {factId: factId}]->(object)
  SET r.supportCount = supportCount
  WITH f, r, supportCount
  WHERE supportCount = 0
  DELETE r
  DETACH DELETE f
  RETURN count(*) AS removedFacts
}
WITH entityIds
UNWIND entityIds AS entityId
MATCH (entity:Entity {entityId: entityId})
WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (:Chunk)-[:MENTIONS]->(entity) }
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (:Fact)-[:SUBJECT|OBJECT]->(entity) }
DETACH DELETE entity;

name: 4 - Fact Evidence and query graph
description: Explicit Evidence nodes add an independent extraction lifecycle to the recommended pattern.

name: Step 1 - Reset and constrain
description: Delete the demo graph and constrain all stable identifiers.

name: Step 2 - Add DOC-1
description: Idempotently create one detailed Evidence item and materialize its Fact as TREATS.
query:
// Evidence is first-class because it has role bindings and its own review lifecycle.
MERGE (d:Document {documentId: 'DOC-1'})
SET d.title = 'Aspirin for migraine', d.version = 1
MERGE (c:Chunk {chunkId: 'DOC-1-C1'})
SET c.text = 'Aspirin treats migraine.'
MERGE (c)-[:PART_OF]->(d)
MERGE (drug:Entity:Drug {entityId: 'DRUG-ASPIRIN'})
  ON CREATE SET drug.name = 'Aspirin'
MERGE (indication:Entity:Indication {entityId: 'IND-MIGRAINE'})
  ON CREATE SET indication.name = 'Migraine'
MERGE (subjectMention:EntityMention {mentionId: 'DOC-1-C1|RUN-1|MENTION-1'})
SET subjectMention.surfaceForm = 'Aspirin', subjectMention.start = 0, subjectMention.end = 7
MERGE (objectMention:EntityMention {mentionId: 'DOC-1-C1|RUN-1|MENTION-2'})
SET objectMention.surfaceForm = 'migraine', objectMention.start = 15, objectMention.end = 23
MERGE (c)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(subjectMention)
MERGE (c)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(objectMention)
MERGE (subjectMention)-[:RESOLVED_TO]->(drug)
MERGE (objectMention)-[:RESOLVED_TO]->(indication)
MERGE (f:Fact {factId: 'DRUG-ASPIRIN|TREATS|IND-MIGRAINE'})
  ON CREATE SET f.predicate = 'TREATS'
MERGE (f)-[:SUBJECT]->(drug)
MERGE (f)-[:OBJECT]->(indication)
MERGE (e:Evidence {evidenceId: 'DOC-1-C1|RUN-1|OCC-1'})
ON CREATE SET e.reviewStatus = 'UNREVIEWED'
SET e.quotation = 'Aspirin treats migraine.',
    e.confidence = 0.91, e.extractorVersion = 'demo-v1', e.extractionRunId = 'RUN-1',
    e.page = 1, e.section = 'Abstract'
MERGE (c)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(e)
MERGE (e)-[:SUBJECT_MENTION]->(subjectMention)
MERGE (e)-[:OBJECT_MENTION]->(objectMention)
MERGE (e)-[:SUPPORTS]->(f)
MERGE (drug)-[r:TREATS {factId: f.factId}]->(indication)
WITH f, r
MATCH (current:Evidence)-[:SUPPORTS]->(f)
WITH r, count(current) AS supportCount
SET r.supportCount = supportCount;

description: The application query remains identical and does not traverse provenance nodes.
query:
MATCH p=(drug:Drug)-[r:TREATS]->(indication:Indication)
RETURN p;

name: Step 7b - Cite the domain relationship
description: Traverse from the native query graph to its detailed Evidence and source documents.
query:
MATCH (drug:Drug)-[r:TREATS]->(indication:Indication)
MATCH (f:Fact {factId: r.factId})<-[:SUPPORTS]-(e:Evidence)<-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]-(c:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document)
MATCH (e)-[:SUBJECT_MENTION]->(subjectMention:EntityMention)
MATCH (e)-[:OBJECT_MENTION]->(objectMention:EntityMention)
RETURN drug.name AS subject, type(r) AS predicate, indication.name AS object,
       d.documentId AS documentId, d.title AS source, c.chunkId AS chunkId,
       e.quotation AS excerpt, e.confidence AS confidence,
       e.extractorVersion AS extractorVersion, e.reviewStatus AS reviewStatus,
       subjectMention.mentionId AS subjectMentionId,
       objectMention.mentionId AS objectMentionId;

name: Step 8 - Delete DOC-1
description: Delete its Evidence mentions and update only the Fact projection and entities it touched.
query:
// Capture touched IDs before deleting document-owned Evidence and mentions.
MATCH (d:Document {documentId: 'DOC-1'})<-[:PART_OF]-(c:Chunk)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:HAS_MENTION]->(mention:EntityMention)-[:RESOLVED_TO]->(entity:Entity)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(e:Evidence)-[:SUPPORTS]->(f:Fact)
WITH d, collect(DISTINCT c) AS chunks, collect(DISTINCT mention) AS mentions,
     collect(DISTINCT e) AS evidence,
     [id IN collect(DISTINCT f.factId) WHERE id IS NOT NULL] AS factIds,
     [id IN collect(DISTINCT entity.entityId) WHERE id IS NOT NULL] AS entityIds
FOREACH (e IN evidence | DETACH DELETE e)
FOREACH (mention IN mentions | DETACH DELETE mention)
FOREACH (c IN chunks | DETACH DELETE c)
DETACH DELETE d
CALL (factIds) {
  // Reconcile only touched Facts and their native projections.
  UNWIND factIds AS factId
  MATCH (f:Fact {factId: factId})
  MATCH (f)-[:SUBJECT]->(subject:Entity)
  MATCH (f)-[:OBJECT]->(object:Entity)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (remaining:Evidence)-[:SUPPORTS]->(f)
  WITH f, subject, object, factId, count(remaining) AS supportCount
  OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[r:TREATS {factId: factId}]->(object)
  SET r.supportCount = supportCount
  WITH f, r, supportCount
  WHERE supportCount = 0
  DELETE r
  DETACH DELETE f
  RETURN count(*) AS removedFacts
}
WITH entityIds
UNWIND entityIds AS entityId
MATCH (entity:Entity {entityId: entityId})
WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (:EntityMention)-[:RESOLVED_TO]->(entity) }
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (:Fact)-[:SUBJECT|OBJECT]->(entity) }
DETACH DELETE entity;

name: Step 9 - Verify the result
description: DOC-2 Evidence Fact and the single canonical TREATS relationship remain.
query:
MATCH p=(drug:Drug)-[r:TREATS]->(indication:Indication)
MATCH (d:Document)<-[:PART_OF]-(:Chunk)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(e:Evidence)-[:SUPPORTS]->(f:Fact)
WHERE f.factId = r.factId
RETURN p, r.supportCount AS supportCount, d.documentId AS document, e.evidenceId AS evidence;
